title: As Kirk Cousins sparks Vikings, Fernando Mendoza reflects on Raiders debut: 'It's good to get punched in the face'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: As Kirk Cousins sparks Vikings, Fernando Mendoza reflects on Raiders debut: 'It's good to get punched in the face'
sources.description: Perhaps Cousins' summation of his day applies to both teams. "There's just so much football ahead," Cousins said, "and this story is going to get written much later than now."
